evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 藻园
evidence.excerpt_zh: 長春仙館由西南門迤西為藻園内為曠然堂五楹堂後為貯清書屋曠然堂東池上為夕佳書屋稍北為鏡瀾榭東南樓為凝眺為懷新館西北為湛碧軒西南為湛清華（圓明園冊）臣等謹按藻園曠然堂諸額皆皇上御書
evidence.summary: Out by the south-west gate of 長春仙館: 藻園 with the five-bay 曠然堂, 貯清書屋, 夕佳書屋, 鏡瀾榭, the tower 凝眺, 懷新館, 湛碧軒 and 湛清華.

evidence.title: 旷然堂: 乾隆三十一年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆三十一年 (1766), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 林木翳然处，视听却旷然。盖无系于物，率可得乎天。不爱花锦绣，宁须禽管弦。芸编足讨绎，久矣共周旋。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 旷然堂, 1766, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 旷然堂: 乾隆五十八年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆五十八年 (1793), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 溪堂枕碧漪，明照暎檐楣。长物本无矣，虚怀自有之。风轻纨弗起，月浄鉴恒披。絜矩于何是，施乎政允宜。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 旷然堂, 1793, on escaping the heat. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 题旷然堂
evidence.locator: v3 p.227, under 藻园; source ref 18-586
evidence.excerpt_zh: 溪堂枕碧漪，明照映檐楣。长物本无矣，虚怀自有之。风轻纨弗起，月净鉴恒披。絜矩于何是，施乎政允宜
evidence.summary: Poem 题旷然堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1793, filed by the editors under 藻园.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 旷然堂
evidence.summary: 旷然堂: 2 dated items, 1766-1793, of which 2 poems (Qianlong); recurring themes: the view, escaping the heat. First dated 1766, last dated 1793.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
